current_value_mm: (-330, 0, 480) on link_1_s; z SCALED off print sheet 2, rearward offset PHOTO
how_to_measure: Tape from the robot base mounting plane up to the spool hub centre (arbor nut) and horizontally back from the base centre; record the S-axis pose used. The user has confirmed that the housing rotates with S, so only the installed offsets remain open.

parameter: robot S-axis to front and rear fence outside faces
how_to_measure: Measure from a plumb mark of the robot S-axis to the front and rear outside frame faces; record member thickness separately from the floor-layout datums.

parameter: robot base centre to the LEFT and RIGHT fence rails
how_to_measure: Measure from a plumb mark of the robot S-axis to the left and right outside frame faces; identify outside faces separately from the floor-layout datums.

parameter: platter surface height and tilt; separate physical surface from the TCP command datum
current_value_mm: 84.251 above axis is the command datum; raw single touch was 77.901
how_to_measure: Collect additional well-spread surface measurements with their raw robot pulses and measurement reference; record actual wire extension or verified contact-tip-to-TCP offset, and retain the existing single-point evidence.
NOTES: Wire touched off on the platter work face at pulses (-1691, 33350, -49764, 6597, 14034, -2639); FK puts the RAW touch at z 140.501 vs the modelled 165.8, i.e. -25.299 AT THE 1/8 in stickout it was touched off at. THE APPLIED OFFSET IS -18.949, NOT -25.3 - that is what docs/cell-calibration.json holds, because cell_lc.offset_from_touch_off() folds the process stickout into the geometry offset and only touch_stickout - weld_stickout survives (3.175 - 9.525). Re-derive the face height with -25.3 and you seat the job for welding at the 1/8 in it was touched off at rather than the 3/8 in it welds at, which drives 6.35 mm of wire into the plate; the error is not symmetric - welding LONGER than you touched off cuts in, welding shorter only lifts the arc. Either way the LEVEL 45-deg pair (+73.9) was right to within 4.0 mm and the +103.2 in use was 25.3 mm high. Never hand-edit the offset; re-derive with offset_from_touch_off(). THE STICKOUT CORRECTION IS SETTLED, not assumed 0 and UNVERIFIED as an earlier version of this note said: touch_stickout_mm 3.175 and weld_stickout_mm 9.525 are recorded in docs/cell-calibration.json and are exactly what produced -18.949. CAVEAT that does stand: ONE XY point, so tilt is not seen - handoff H3 wants two more touch-offs well apart. See docs/pendant-capture-2026-09-03.md

parameter: station axis height above the robot base plane
how_to_measure: Lay a straightedge across the robot base mounting plane and measure vertically to the faceplate centre — one direct tape, no shared floor datum (this settles the print's 923 vs the manual's 936).

parameter: station axis line, forward of the robot S axis
how_to_measure: Snap a chalk line on the floor through the robot pedestal centre parallel to the front fence, then tape from it to a plumb drop off the faceplate centre.

parameter: faceplate plane, right of the robot central axis
how_to_measure: Hold a square on the faceplate face and tape horizontally along the station axis to the robot's central (S) axis plumb line.

parameter: reamer stand base position relative to the robot base centre (forward and lateral)
how_to_measure: Tape on the floor from the robot pedestal's front face and right face to the two nearest corners of the reamer stand's base plate.

parameter: station S-zero direction (which way the axis points at 0 deg) and rotation sense
how_to_measure: At the pendant, jog the station +10 deg from zero and photograph the platter before and after; or read the station calibration out of the dump.

parameter: which optional functions are enabled — coordinated motion (positioner rotation) and searching (touch sense)
current_value_mm: R1+S1 calibration records exist; option list and SRCH enablement unconfirmed
how_to_measure: MAIN MENU > SYSTEM INFO > OPTION FUNCTION and photograph the whole list; coordinated motion gates every rotating job and searching gates touch sense.

parameter: station (EC) encoder pulses per degree — the one number that unblocks emitting positioner rotation
how_to_measure: Capture S1 pulse and angle readings at two distinct known positions, using the same position for each paired reading; differences determine scale without assuming the encoder zero offset.

current_value_mm: TOOL 0 pendant: X -110.247 Y 0.324 Z 351.972; Rx 0 Ry -45 Rz 0

See docs/pendant-capture-2026-09-03.md

parameter: contents of ASF#12 and AEF#12 (the arc start/end condition files the generated wall job calls)
how_to_measure: ARC WELDING > ARC START COND, open file 12 and photograph every window, then the same for ARC END COND 12; we are calling these without knowing them.

parameter: CAD_FIXTURE_001 installed pose and clamped work surface
current_value_mm: 508 x 254 x 50.8 CAD; installed pose unknown
how_to_measure: Confirm whether the slotted WAAM fixture is installed, locate three mounting datums, and record touch-off points on the actual clamped work surface.

parameter: housing, spindle, rotating support and bracket attachment
current_value_mm: 240 diameter x 100 housing; S-axis rotation confirmed; shape provisional
how_to_measure: Measure the housing, window, spindle and support plates; record their mounting datums in the S-axis frame.

parameter: 185712-1 flexible conduit ends, clips, diameter and slack
current_value_mm: 18 OD display curve between S-link housing and U-link feeder; provisional
how_to_measure: Record the conduit inlet/outlet and clamp locations, diameter and free length at known S/L/U poses; verify the path through the working range.

parameter: faceplate face overhang past the front of the stand column
how_to_measure: Hold a square against the faceplate face and measure horizontally back along the station axis to the front face of the stand column.

parameter: stand column section across the station axis
how_to_measure: Tape the positioner column across both faces at chest height; record both directions if it is not square.

parameter: stand base plate height above the cell base rail
how_to_measure: Rest a rule on the top of the cell's bottom aluminium base rail beside the column and measure up to the underside of the column base plate.

parameter: knurled-screw fixture block L x W x H
how_to_measure: Tape the fixture plate on the platter in all three directions, measuring the plate body only (not the knurled screws).

parameter: fixture block centre distance from the faceplate plane
how_to_measure: Hook the tape on the faceplate face and measure along the platter centreline to the near edge of the fixture plate.

parameter: semicircular gusset diameter
how_to_measure: Tape across the flat top edge of the half-disc gusset at the faceplate end — that chord is the full diameter.

parameter: stand post section (mid-height)
how_to_measure: Tape across the reamer stand's tapered column at half its height, in both directions.

parameter: pedestal column section
how_to_measure: Tape across the robot pedestal column at mid height in both directions, clear of the cable entry.

parameter: pedestal top plate L x W x T
how_to_measure: Tape the plate the robot base bolts to, across both directions, and caliper its edge thickness.

parameter: fence overall height above the cell base
how_to_measure: Stand the tape on the floor against a corner post and read the height of the top rail's upper surface.

parameter: door opening centre offset along the front face
how_to_measure: Tape from the outside face of the left front corner post to the near jamb post of the door opening.

parameter: intermediate post spacing on the back and side faces
how_to_measure: Walk the fence and tape post-centre to post-centre along the back face and each side, recording each bay in order.

parameter: 4R100 body X/Y slide position on the K3572 top sheet

parameter: disconnect enclosure body and mounting position

parameter: outside envelope versus 2000 x 2000 floor-layout datums

current_value_mm: 100 x 80 perimeter rails; 115 pitch / 12.6 bores per sheet 5; layout provisional

current_value_mm: 460 x 460 x 20 foot; 120 gusset drop; provisional
how_to_measure: Measure the pedestal foot plate, triangular webs and both bolt patterns without changing the recorded floor-to-mount height.

parameter: station axis height above the headstock foot underside
how_to_measure: Stand a rule on the stand top plate under the headstock foot and measure vertically to the faceplate centre (use the centre bore or the dowel midpoint as the mark).

parameter: plate corner radius
how_to_measure: Lay a radius gauge (or trace onto paper) at one free-end corner of the platter.

parameter: gusset plate thickness
how_to_measure: Caliper the gusset plate on its exposed curved edge below the platter.

parameter: stand floor-foot plate thickness
how_to_measure: Caliper the stand's floor foot at a corner. The booklet dimensions the head mounting plate instead; the floor foot's width, depth and thickness are unverified.

parameter: stand floor-foot width
how_to_measure: Measure the floor foot across its first side; identify this side in a photograph. The booklet's 243.2 mm belongs to the head plate, not this foot.

how_to_measure: Measure the floor foot perpendicular to its first side. The booklet's178.2 mm does not dimension this foot.

how_to_measure: Caliper the head mounting plate at an exposed edge above the stand; the booklet dimensions its XY footprint, not thickness or centering under the head.

parameter: infill panel slab thickness
how_to_measure: Caliper a fence panel at the door jamb where its edge is exposed in the extrusion slot.

parameter: installed inlet/outlet orientation of the supplied K3560 CAD
current_value_mm: CAD fitting axis native Y; barbed negative-Y end used as inlet

parameter: duct diameter above the cone
how_to_measure: Wrap a tape around the duct just above the cone collar and divide the circumference by pi.

parameter: hood mouth plane height above the floor

how_to_measure: Drop a plumb bob from the hood cone's centre and tape from the mark on the floor to the robot pedestal's front and right faces.
